item.text:
Added [proxy.ts](/home/sandbox/workspace/proxy.ts) using the current Next.js 16 `proxy` convention. It logs each request’s pathname to the server console and sets a unique `X-Request-Id` response header.

The production build passed. Live checks confirmed that successful and 404 responses receive distinct IDs and that their pathnames appear in the server log.
